column3: Although we were enthusiastic and fired up for the finals, we regrettably lost.
We were too ashamed to face Kirino... Even Kuroneko bit her lips out of frustration.
I will not make excuses, so go ahead and scold me.
For the two of you... It wasn't bad.
N-Nothing! Besides that, look at this! The runner-up's prize!
Kirino held up a colored paper bearing the signature of the seiyuu.
Although we missed the victory, the second place prize is also gorgeous.
Saori held a limited edition Siscaly artbook and appeared to be very happy.
Although we didn't get complete victory... this, well, is good enough.
Looking at my ecstatic sister and her friends, my heart was warming up.
